EMPLOYMENT OFFER LETTER

Dear Ms. Rivera,

We are pleased to offer you the position of Senior Data Analyst at Lakeview
Analytics Inc., reporting to the Head of Data Science.

Start date: April 6, 2026
Annual salary: $92,000, paid monthly, subject to standard tax withholding.
Probationary period: three months, during which either party may terminate
employment with two weeks' written notice.

Benefits include health insurance, 25 days of paid annual leave, and a
retirement plan with employer matching up to 4% of salary.

This offer is contingent upon a standard background check and proof of your
right to work. Please sign and return this letter within two weeks if you
wish to accept.

If you have any questions, feel free to contact HR or your recruiter at any
time before accepting.

We look forward to welcoming you to the team.

Sincerely,
Lakeview Analytics Inc., Human Resources
